all_required: scope_type and sorted family/product/configuration/region sets exact match
scope clarification and resolution status exact match
required tool order appears as a subsequence and forbidden tools are absent
clarification and abstention behavior exact match

metrics.clear_hard_constraint_precision: TP / (TP + FP) over active supported hard constraint tuples
metrics.clear_hard_constraint_recall: TP / (TP + FN) over active supported hard constraint tuples
metrics.clear_hard_constraint_f1: harmonic mean of clear hard-constraint precision and recall
metrics.recommendation_evidence_coverage: identity-closed matched key Evidence requirements present / all matched key Evidence requirements for returned candidates
metrics.wrong_configuration_recommendations: returned candidate configurations outside frozen expected scope
metrics.wrong_region_recommendations: returned candidate regions outside frozen expected scope
metrics.candidate_scope_leakage: tool or report product IDs outside resolved scope
metrics.checker_scope_leakage: Checker input IDs outside or different from frozen checker candidate set
metrics.unknown_overclaimed: unknown key Evidence requirement rendered as matched or as a supported fact
metrics.clarification_bypass: clarification_required case that executes decision tools or returns a candidate
metrics.sufficient_evidence_empty_recommendation: eligible cases with empty final set despite at least one frozen eligible candidate / all eligible cases

not_claimed: real-time price or Web Search coverage
